title: Capricor jumped 9% after a White House FDA nomination was withdrawn,with a PDUFA in four days. Real signal, or just a biotech head-fake?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
\[CAPR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CAPR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CAPR/)) jumped from an $8.41 close  
to $9.15, a gain of 8.80%, during Wednesday's regular session after  
already trading higher in premarket.  
  
The move followed news that the White House withdrew Dr. Heidi  
Overton's nomination to lead the FDA, which lifted biotech names with  
pending agency decisions. Capricor also has a Nov. 22 PDUFA date for  
deramiocel, so some of this may be positioning into that decision.  
  
Why \[CAPR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CAPR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CAPR/)) bounced today, including  
the withdrawn nomination and the upcoming PDUFA:  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-capricor-therapeutics-capr-stock-up-8-80-today-40565/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-capricor-therapeutics-capr-stock-up-8-80-today-40565/)  
  
Is a withdrawn nomination actually meaningful for an approval in four  
days, or is this just a thin biotech tape looking for a headline?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's write-up, not a live quote.
